summary: There is no loading state: while query.isLoading is true the metric cards render 0 and the list section is empty with no skeleton or spinner, unlike sibling pages that show pulse skeletons or loading text.
fix: Add a loading branch before the list, e.g. `{query.isLoading ? <section className="space-y-3" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل الإجراءات">{[1,2,3].map((i) => <div key={i} className="card h-28 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" />)}</section> : null}` matching the pattern in LiveLocationPage/ServiceDeskPage.

summary: The 'فتح الإجراء' Link uses a bespoke `bg-brand ... text-white` class stack instead of the shared .btn-primary primitive, diverging from button styling elsewhere (hover/active/focus states, radius).
fix: Replace the inline className with `className="btn-primary shrink-0"` so the CTA inherits the design-system button tokens and interaction states.

summary: The due-date deadline text uses a hardcoded Tailwind color `text-amber-600` instead of the warning design token, so it will not adapt to the dark theme or match .status-warning/priority-icon which use var(--warning).
fix: Change `text-amber-600` to `text-[var(--warning)]`.

summary: The item.status is rendered as raw plain text in a `.muted text-xs` span while kind and priority use StatusBadge, giving inconsistent status treatment within the same badge row.
fix: Render status with the shared primitive too: `<StatusBadge value={item.status} />` for visual and color consistency with kind/priority.

summary: The error condition reuses EmptyState (a neutral empty treatment) with no error styling or icon, so a load failure is visually indistinguishable from a benign 'no items' state.
fix: Give the error case a distinct error banner (danger token surface, e.g. a `.card` with `border-[var(--danger)]`/`text-[var(--danger)]` and an AlertCircle icon) rather than the neutral EmptyState used for the no-items case.

summary: PageHeader is used without the `eyebrow` prop that other top-level feature pages provide, making the header slightly inconsistent with the established page-header pattern.
fix: Add an eyebrow, e.g. `eyebrow="مركز الإجراءات"` (or the relevant module label) to PageHeader for consistency with sibling pages.

summary: The 'مكتمل اليوم' MetricCard is hardcoded to value={0}, so it is a permanently static placeholder metric that never reflects real data.
fix: Either wire it to a real count from the query data, or remove the card until the metric is available, to avoid a misleading always-zero tile (polish/consistency only, no new data flow required if removed).

summary: The page never handles query.isError or query.isLoading, so on a failed fetch it silently renders only the header with no metrics or data, unlike the sibling DisputesPage which shows an EmptyState error banner.
fix: Mirror DisputesPage: after PageHeader render `{query.isError ? <EmptyState title="تعذر تحميل بيانات الحضور" description={query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : 'تحقق من الاتصال والصلاحيات.'} /> : null}` and gate on a loading state (LoadingScreen or a skeleton) while query.isLoading.

summary: The 'فترات الحضور' list renders `data?.periods.map(...)` with no EmptyState fallback, so an empty result shows a bare empty container, inconsistent with the EmptyState used for rosters/corrections.
fix:
Wrap with the same pattern: `{data && data.periods.length === 0 ? :
…
}`.

summary: The 'العمل الإضافي' list renders `data?.overtime.map(...)` with no EmptyState fallback, showing an empty container when there are no overtime requests.
fix: Add an EmptyState fallback matching the corrections pattern, e.g. `{data && data.overtime.length === 0 ? <EmptyState title="لا يوجد عمل إضافي" description="طلبات العمل الإضافي في الشهر المحدد ستظهر هنا." /> : …}`.

summary: The clickable shift cards use a bespoke `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` button with no hover affordance, instead of the shared `.card-interactive` interaction style used for clickable cards.
fix: Add the `card-interactive` class (and cursor/hover) to the shift `<button>`, e.g. `className="card-interactive rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4 text-right"` so it matches the app's interactive-card feedback.

summary: The 'إغلاق الشهر' primary button has no disabled/pending state while commands.closePeriod is running, unlike saveShift (line 42) which disables on isPending.
fix: Add `disabled={commands.closePeriod.isPending}` to the إغلاق الشهر button for consistent submit feedback.

summary: The month picker in PageHeader actions is a bare `<label>` wrapping the input with the text 'الشهر' glued directly to the field and no aria-label, giving a cramped, unlabeled-in-AT control.
fix: Give the input `aria-label="الشهر"` and separate the visible label text (e.g. wrap the caption in a `<span className="block">` or add spacing) so the label reads clearly in RTL and to screen readers.

summary: Section cards use repeated inline `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` article wrappers across corrections/periods/overtime instead of a shared record-card class, duplicating styling that could drift from the design system.
fix: Extract the repeated `rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border)] p-4` into a shared class (e.g. reuse `.mobile-record-card` or a new `.record-card`) and apply it to these article wrappers for consistency.

summary: The corrections empty check `data?.corrections.length === 0` evaluates false while data is undefined (loading), so during load nothing renders with no skeleton, matching a pattern that lacks any loading placeholder.
fix: Once a loading state is added (see line 18 finding), render a lightweight skeleton or spinner for these lists while query.isLoading rather than an empty gap.

summary: The feedback banner uses hardcoded Tailwind palette colors (emerald-500/red-500/emerald-800/red-800) instead of the app's success/danger design tokens, so it will not adapt to dark theme or match the brand system.
fix: Replace with token-based styling, e.g. success = border-[var(--success)]/bg-[var(--success-soft)]/text-[var(--success)] and error = border-[var(--danger)]/bg-[var(--danger-soft)]/text-[var(--danger)].

summary: The page never renders a loading state while query.isLoading (only guards the empty state at line 174), so on first load the list area appears empty with no skeleton, diverging from the app's animate-pulse card skeleton pattern.
fix: Add a loading branch consistent with peers, e.g. render `{query.isLoading ? <div className="card h-72 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل القضايا" /> : ...}` before the list, matching OperationsCenterPage/ServiceDeskPage.

summary: A bespoke filter section reimplements search + selects instead of reusing the shared FilterBar primitive, so it lacks the standard heading, the clear-all control, and the aria-live result count that FilterBar provides.
fix: Replace the hand-rolled section with <FilterBar searchValue={search} onSearchChange={setSearch} searchPlaceholder="…" resultText={`${filteredCases.length} نتيجة`} isDirty={search!=='' || statusFilter!=='open' || priorityFilter!=='all'} onClear={() => { setSearch(''); setStatusFilter('open'); setPriorityFilter('all'); }}> with the two selects as children.

summary: The overdue review-deadline emphasis uses hardcoded text-red-700 (and text-red-700 again at line 288) instead of the --danger token, breaking dark-theme adaptation and token consistency.
fix: Use text-[var(--danger)] in place of text-red-700 for the overdue deadline strong (line 183) and the critical-alert AlertTriangle icon (line 288).

summary: The completed-action proof confirmation uses hardcoded emerald-500/10 background and emerald-800 text instead of the --success-soft / --success tokens.
fix: Change to className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-[var(--success-soft)] p-3 text-sm text-[var(--success)]".

summary: Several functional selects have no accessible label (the 'المحقق أو المسؤول' assignee select at line 201, the transition action/target/priority selects at 210-212, committee member/role selects at 222-223, note type/visibility at 232-233, session/decision/settlement selects), relying only on a placeholder-like first <option> which is not an accessible name.
fix: Add an aria-label to each select (e.g. aria-label="المحقق أو المسؤول", "إجراء المسار", "دور العضو", "نوع الملاحظة", "ظهور الملاحظة") matching FilterBar's labelled-control convention.

summary: Case status/priority/overdue are communicated only via colored StatusBadges and the overdue deadline is conveyed by color alone (line 183), which is a color-only signal risk if any badge variant lacks a text label.
fix: Ensure StatusBadge renders a text label for every value used here (status, priority, 'overdue') and keep the textual remainingLabel adjacent so overdue state is not color-only.

summary: The selected case card uses the utility class `border-brand`, which is not defined in styles.css (only .filter-chip references brand borders), so the active selection border likely falls back to default and is inconsistent with the token-based border-[var(--border-strong)] used elsewhere.
fix: Replace `border-brand` with a defined token border such as border-[var(--brand-primary)] (or add a .border-brand utility) to give the selected case a visible brand-colored outline.

summary: The page never renders query.isError, unlike every sibling page (DisputesPage, PerformancePage, AttendancePage, etc.) which show an EmptyState/alert on load failure, so a failed fetch silently shows zeroed metrics and empty sections.
fix: After PageHeader, add the app-standard error guard: {query.isError ? <EmptyState title="تعذر تحميل دورات KPI" description={query.error instanceof Error ? query.error.message : 'تحقق من الاتصال والصلاحيات.'} /> : null}

summary: There is no loading state while query.isLoading; metrics render 0 and lists render empty during fetch, whereas the app uses LoadingScreen/skeletons for the initial load.
fix: Guard the initial load, e.g. render <LoadingScreen /> (or skeleton cards) when query.isLoading && !data before the metric/section blocks, matching the established loading pattern.

summary: The override-reason line uses hardcoded Tailwind color text-amber-700 instead of the warning design token, so it does not adapt to dark theme like the rest of the UI.
fix: Replace className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700" with a token-based color, e.g. text-[var(--warning)].

summary: The 'الدورات الحالية' list maps data?.cycles with no empty state, so when there are zero cycles the section is silently blank, inconsistent with the appeals section on line 75 which uses EmptyState.
fix: When data?.cycles.length === 0 render an EmptyState (e.g. title="لا توجد دورات لهذا الشهر" description="جهّز دورة الشهر من البطاقة المجاورة.") instead of an empty mapped list.

summary: The datetime-local extension input has no associated label or aria-label (unlike its sibling reason input which has a placeholder), so it is unlabeled for screen readers.
fix: Add aria-label="تاريخ ووقت التمديد" to the datetime-local input (and similarly ensure the month input's control on line 55 exposes its label).

summary: The month picker is a bespoke inline label+input placed in PageHeader actions rather than using the shared FilterBar, which is the app's standard control surface for filtering by period.
fix: Consider moving the month selector into a FilterBar (or at least reuse its control styling) so period filtering is visually and behaviorally consistent with other list pages; keep it inline only if FilterBar is genuinely too heavy here.

summary: MetricCards for التقييمات/المكتملة/الاعتراضات omit the hint/trend props that MetricCard supports, leaving useful context (e.g. finalized ratio, overdue count) unsurfaced compared to richer metric rows elsewhere.
fix: Add hint text where meaningful, e.g. hint on المكتملة showing the finalized/evaluations percentage, using MetricCard's hint prop.
Guard the render: if (query.isLoading) return <LoadingScreen />; and render an error banner (danger-soft) when query.isError, instead of only conditionally rendering on data.
summary: The page never renders a loading screen or error banner; while useLifecycleOperations is fetching, metrics and all data-bound sections silently disappear (data ? ... : null) and query errors are ignored.

fix: Add aria-label to each select (e.g. 'نوع العهدة', 'اختر عهدة', 'الموظف', 'سبب الإنهاء', 'موظف الاستلام') matching the placeholder/first option text.
summary: The asset type <select> (and the assignment, offboarding reason, and handover selects on lines 28/34) have no aria-label and no associated <label>, so screen readers announce them with no name.

fix: Add aria-label to each input mirroring its placeholder, or wrap each in a <label> as done for the date fields on line 34.
summary: All text inputs (asset code/name/serial/condition/location) rely solely on placeholder text as their label, so they have no accessible name once a value is typed.

fix: Use grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 for the three input rows so fields stack on mobile, consistent with the responsive grids used elsewhere on the page.
summary: The asset form uses fixed grid-cols-2 for its input rows, forcing two cramped columns on narrow/mobile viewports instead of stacking.

fix: Replace window.prompt with an in-app modal/inline reason field using the app's card/input primitives to keep RTL, Cairo font, and focus management.
summary: Document reject and clearance waive actions collect the reason via window.prompt, a non-styled, non-accessible native dialog that breaks the RTL Arabic design system.

fix: Reuse the established .mobile-record-card (or a shared record-row component) for the document and offboarding case rows so spacing, radius, and typography stay consistent.
summary: Section list items use an ad-hoc rounded-2xl border wrapper and inline muted paragraphs instead of the shared record-row/card patterns used elsewhere in the app.

fix: Hoist the filtered documents into a useMemo and surface a result count consistent with FilterBar's resultText convention.
summary: The document expiry filter is computed inline and repeated twice with no result count, unlike other list views that surface a resultText.

fix: Align the metrics grid gap with the surrounding sections and reserve its space during loading to avoid layout shift.
summary: The MetricCard row uses gap-4 while sibling sections use gap-6, and it only renders when data exists, causing layout shift on load.
Rules list uses hardcoded Tailwind palette colors (text-amber-500, text-emerald-500) instead of design tokens, so they won't adapt to the brand/dark theme.
fix: Replace text-amber-500 with text-[var(--warning)] and text-emerald-500 with text-[var(--success)] to match the token system already used elsewhere (text-brand is used on the same line).

summary: The page renders nothing while data is loading (only handles data-present and isError), unlike the established skeleton pattern used on ServiceDesk/LiveLocation pages.
fix: Add a loading branch when query.isLoading (e.g. render the metric grid + cards as `card h-44 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]` skeletons like ServiceDeskPage) before the `data ?` block.

summary: The refresh button is a bespoke inline-styled control instead of reusing .btn-secondary, and it lives in a custom toolbar rather than PageHeader's actions slot.
fix: Pass the refresh button into PageHeader via the `actions` prop and give it className="btn-secondary", removing the hand-rolled `inline-flex ... rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] px-3 py-2` styling.

summary: The error EmptyState offers no retry action even though query.refetch is available, so users hit a dead end on load failure.
fix: Add an action to the error EmptyState, e.g. action={{ label: 'إعادة المحاولة', onClick: () => void query.refetch() }} (matching EmptyState's action API).

summary: Status meaning in the rules list is conveyed by icon color alone (amber vs emerald vs brand) with no text/aria label, failing color-only status guidance.
fix: Add aria-hidden to the decorative icons or give each an aria-label describing its semantic (تحذير / مؤكد / معلومة); rely on the adjacent Arabic text for meaning rather than color.

summary: The 'incomplete' and 'pendingReview' figures are rendered as bespoke tiles (rounded-2xl bg surface-muted with 3xl numbers) instead of reusing MetricCard like the four cards directly above them.
fix: Render these two figures with the shared MetricCard component (label/value/hint) for visual and spacing consistency with the metric grid at lines 19-24.

summary: The date/refresh toolbar uses a one-off rounded-2xl border+surface container instead of the shared .card class used by every other panel on the page.
fix: If kept as a separate bar, use className="card" (or fold the date into PageHeader) so radius/border/shadow match the .card panels at lines 26-27.

summary: The refresh button gives no accessible indication of the fetching state beyond the visually-spinning icon.
fix: Add aria-busy={query.isFetching} (and optionally aria-label='تحديث') to the button, and mark the RefreshCcw icon aria-hidden.

summary: The error alert banner uses hardcoded light-mode Tailwind reds (border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800) with no dark-theme handling, so on [data-theme='dark'] it renders a jarring bright light-red box.
fix: Use the design-system danger tokens as AppErrorBoundary does: className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--danger)]/30 bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-3 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]", which adapt to dark theme automatically.

summary: The two field-error spans (identifier line 70, password line 71) have no reserved height, so the card layout shifts vertically each time a validation message appears or disappears.
fix: Add a reserved min-height to the error spans as CreateEmployeePage's Field does, e.g. className="mt-1 block min-h-4 text-xs text-red-700" (or text-[var(--danger)]) to prevent layout jump.

summary: Brand-panel accent text uses raw Tailwind colors (text-cyan-200 line 42, text-blue-100 lines 44/46/50-52) instead of the brand accent token, so the brand identity color is not driven by the design system and can drift from --brand-accent.
fix: Replace ad-hoc cyan/blue text utilities with tokenized values (e.g. an on-gradient class or text-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--brand-accent),white_40%)]) so the accent stays tied to --brand-accent.

summary: The feature cards use a non-standard opacity utility bg-white/8, which is not a canonical Tailwind opacity step and reads inconsistently with the rest of the panel's border-white/15.
fix: Use a canonical or explicit arbitrary opacity, e.g. bg-white/10 or bg-white/[0.08], to match Tailwind's supported scale and the surrounding /15 border.

summary: When Supabase is unconfigured the submit button is disabled (line 72) but the explanatory warning (line 75) only renders when devMocks is also off, so in dev-mock builds the button is silently disabled with no adjacent reason.
fix: Show a short inline hint next to the disabled submit button whenever !hasSupabaseConfig (independent of devMocksEnabled), or associate it via aria-describedby so users understand why login is blocked.

Color the icon by state using tokens, e.g. add a state color alongside the existing Icon ternary: `text-[var(--danger)]` for blocked, `text-[var(--warning)]` for maintenance, `text-[var(--brand-primary)]` for update_required.
summary: The status icon has no color, so danger/maintenance/update states all render as a neutral gray icon with no visual severity cue, unlike sibling LoginPage which colors icons with brand/status tokens.

fix: Add `role="alert"` to the container in WebReleaseCheckError and the blocked branch, and give the icon a `text-[var(--danger)]` token color so the failure reads as an error rather than neutral info.
summary: The check-error and blocked states convey a hard failure but the container is a plain neutral .card with an uncolored icon and no alert semantics, inconsistent with the app's error-banner pattern (LoginPage uses role="alert" with danger styling).

fix: Add `aria-hidden="true"` to the decorative Icon/CloudOff/RefreshCcw icons since the state is already in the heading text, and pair with the token color fix so state is not conveyed by icon shape alone.
summary: Severity is communicated by icon shape and text only; the icon carries no accessible label/color and is not marked decorative, so screen readers announce nothing meaningful for the state.

fix: Add `<AppLogo />` above the icon/title inside the card (import from '../../ui/AppLogo'), matching LoginPage's branded pre-auth layout.
summary: These are full-screen pre-auth gate pages (same context as LoginPage) but they show no AppLogo, so the association's brand identity is absent on a top-level screen where LoginPage renders <AppLogo>.

fix: Extract the shared centered-card gate shell (icon, title, message, optional detail, retry button) into one small local component used by both WebReleaseStatusPage and WebReleaseCheckError to keep spacing/markup consistent.
summary: The two near-identical page shells (icon + title + message + retry) are duplicated inline instead of sharing a single component, risking spacing/markup drift between the two gate screens.

fix: Reformat the JSX in both components onto multiple lines matching LoginPage's style so class and spacing changes are reviewable.
summary: Both components are written as single dense one-line JSX returns, inconsistent with the multi-line formatted JSX used elsewhere in the auth feature (LoginPage) and hurting maintainability of spacing/class edits.
The page never renders a loading skeleton or spinner; while query.isLoading is true the feed area is simply empty, unlike the app's LoadingScreen pattern.
fix: Add a loading branch before the results section, e.g. render a skeleton/spinner (or reuse LoadingScreen semantics with aria-busy) when query.isLoading, so the initial fetch shows feedback instead of a blank grid.

summary: The publish modal's active mode tabs use hardcoded bg-white text-brand, which stays white in dark theme instead of using surface tokens.
fix: Replace bg-white with bg-[var(--surface-raised)] (or bg-[var(--surface)]) so the active tab respects the dark theme like other raised surfaces.

summary: The save-error message uses hardcoded text-red-600 instead of the danger design token.
fix: Replace text-red-600 with text-[var(--danger)] to align with the design-system danger color and dark-theme support.

summary: The header action and modal submit buttons reimplement button styles inline (bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 / rounded-xl bg-brand px-5 py-3) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class.
fix: Use className="btn-primary" (with the icon child) for the header 'عنصر رسمي جديد' button and the modal submit button to match the app-wide button styling.

summary: The modal close (X) button is icon-only with no accessible label.
fix: Add aria-label="إغلاق" to the close button so screen readers announce its purpose.

summary: The modal is a custom overlay without dialog semantics (no role="dialog", aria-modal, or labelled title) and no Escape/backdrop-close handling.
fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing to the modal title heading, matching the app's modal accessibility pattern.

summary: The decision action button reimplements a bespoke style (bg-[var(--surface-muted)] text-brand) rather than using the shared .btn-secondary primitive.
fix: Replace the inline classes with className="btn-secondary" (keeping the disabled/icon children) for consistency with secondary actions elsewhere.

summary: The acknowledgement progress bar is purely visual with no accessible role or value exposed to assistive tech.
fix: Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax (or aria-label with the count) on the progress container so the acknowledgement ratio is announced.

summary: Error banner uses hardcoded red-200/red-50/red-800 Tailwind colors instead of the --danger/--danger-soft design tokens, so it will not adapt to dark theme.
fix: Replace with token-driven classes, e.g. className="mb-5 rounded-xl border border-[var(--danger)] bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]" (matching the app's .status-danger pattern).

summary: Success banner hardcodes emerald-200/emerald-50/emerald-800 instead of --success/--success-soft tokens, breaking dark-theme and brand consistency.
fix: Use border-[var(--success)] bg-[var(--success-soft)] text-[var(--success)] instead of the emerald-* utilities.

summary: Step indicator's completed/current states use hardcoded emerald-300/emerald-50/emerald-800 rather than success tokens, inconsistent with the tokenized theme.
fix: Swap emerald-* for --success tokens (e.g. border-[var(--success)] bg-[var(--success-soft)] text-[var(--success)]) for the completed step while keeping the brand classes for the active step.

summary: Primary/next/submit buttons are bespoke inline styles (bg-brand px-5 py-3 ...) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class, and the prev/back buttons reimplement .btn-secondary.
fix: Apply className="btn-primary" to next/submit buttons and className="btn-secondary" to the previous and header back buttons, removing the duplicated inline padding/color utilities.

summary: Remove-photo button and photo-error text hardcode red-200/red-700 rather than the --danger token.
fix:
Use border-[var(--danger)] text-[var(--danger)] (and text-[var(--danger)] for the error

at line 123) instead of red-* utilities.

summary: The role <select> (المنصب) and the structure SelectField/JobTitleField selects rely only on a visible label sibling with no aria-label, and icon-only nature of some controls is fine but selects lack explicit accessible naming for screen readers in RTL.
fix: Add aria-label matching each field label to the select/input elements (e.g. aria-label="المنصب" on line 130 select and pass label through as aria-label in SelectField/JobTitleField), consistent with FilterBar's aria-labeled selects.

summary: The structure lookups error uses hardcoded red-50/red-700 while the rest of the app uses tokenized banners, and there is no loading skeleton shown while lookups.isLoading.
fix: Use --danger tokens for the error banner and add a lightweight loading state (e.g. disabled selects or a small spinner) when lookups.isLoading, matching LoadingScreen/app patterns.

summary: Placeholder icon and helper text use the ad-hoc 'muted' class and text-[var(--muted)]; the documented token is --text-muted, so --muted may be an undefined/legacy var.
fix: Confirm the token name and use text-[var(--text-muted)] for the ImagePlus placeholder and helper copy to align with the documented design tokens.

summary: Error banner uses hardcoded Tailwind red-200/red-50/red-800 colors instead of the --danger / --danger-soft design tokens, so it will not adapt in dark theme.
fix: Replace the classes with token-based styling, e.g. className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--danger)] bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-4 text-sm text-[var(--danger)]" (mirroring the sibling components' use of design tokens) so the banner works in both light and dark themes.

summary: Empty and error states are rendered as plain inline text/table rows instead of the shared EmptyState component used across the app (DisputesPage, OfficialFeedPage, EmployeeDetailPage).
fix: Import EmptyState and render it below the FilterBar for the empty case (e.g. title "لا توجد نتائج مطابقة", description guiding to clear filters) and for the error case, matching the established pattern instead of the bespoke table-cell/mobile-card text.

summary: The empty message "لا توجد نتائج مطابقة" is shown both when no employees exist at all and when filters exclude everything, giving misleading copy for a truly empty directory.
fix: Distinguish the two cases: when all.length === 0 show a first-run empty state (e.g. "لا يوجد موظفون بعد" with the create action if canCreate), and only show "لا توجد نتائج مطابقة" when filters/search are active.

summary: Loading state uses a plain text row/card ("جارٍ تحميل الموظفين…") with no skeleton or spinner, inconsistent with the app's LoadingScreen/animated loading pattern.
fix: Render lightweight skeleton rows/cards (e.g. animate-pulse placeholder rows using --surface-muted) during employees.isLoading, or reuse the app's spinner treatment, so the loading state matches the design system.

summary: Table loading/empty cells add aria-busy is missing, so screen readers are not told the region is loading.
fix: Add aria-busy={employees.isLoading} to the table/section (and role="status" on the loading text) so assistive tech announces the loading state.

summary: The refresh button has visible text "تحديث" but no aria-busy indication while fetching, so the spin state is purely visual.
fix: Add aria-busy={employees.isFetching} (and optionally aria-label) to the refresh button so the fetching state is exposed to assistive technology, not only via the spinning icon.

summary: The desktop table wrapper uses className="card hidden overflow-hidden md:block" while list sections use gap-3; header th cells use ad-hoc px-4 py-3.5 that duplicate .data-table styling.
fix: Verify the bespoke px-4 py-3.5 padding on th/td matches .data-table's built-in cell spacing; if .data-table already defines cell padding, drop the inline overrides to keep table density consistent with other pages.

summary: Loading state is a bespoke single-line card with plain text instead of the shared LoadingScreen primitive or the app's animate-pulse skeleton pattern used on other pages.
fix:
Replace the inline `
جارٍ تحميل ملف الموظف…
` with a skeleton matching the app convention (e.g. `
` as in OperationsCenterPage/AuditSecurityPage) or the `LoadingScreen` primitive.

summary: The back link reimplements a secondary button with ad-hoc utility classes (rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] px-4 py-2.5) instead of the design-system `.btn-secondary` class.
fix: Use `<Link to="/hr/employees" className="btn-secondary"><ArrowRight className="size-4" />عودة للموظفين</Link>` so the back action matches the standard secondary-button styling, focus/hover states, and dark-theme tokens.

summary: The employee photo uses empty alt="" even though it conveys identity, so screen-reader users get no name association for the avatar image.

summary: The 'المشاركة والسلف' panel concatenates two independent lists (campaigns then loans) into one flat divided list with no sub-grouping labels, making the two record types visually indistinguishable.
fix: Either split into two Panels, or add a small group label/sub-header (or differing StatusBadge/icon) so campaign rows and loan rows are visually separable.

Replace the `

جارٍ تحميل بيانات التوظيف…

` with the shared `` (import from '../../ui/LoadingScreen') so the page matches the app's loading pattern instead of a raw text line.

summary: The stage-move `<select>` in the ATS table row is icon/context-only with no accessible name (no aria-label).
fix: Add `aria-label={`نقل ${application.candidateName} إلى مرحلة`}` (or a static "نقل إلى مرحلة") to the `<select className="input max-w-48">` so screen-reader users know what the control changes.

summary: The candidates/stages table is hand-rolled (`w-full min-w-[900px]` + manual `bg-[var(--surface-muted)]` thead) instead of using the shared `.data-table` class used elsewhere.
fix: Apply `className="data-table"` to the `<table>` (keep `min-w-[900px]` if needed) so it inherits sticky header, hover, and header weight styling consistent with other management tables.

summary: Table header cells lack `scope="col"`, weakening screen-reader table navigation.

summary: The Dialog overlay backdrop uses a hardcoded Tailwind color `bg-slate-950/60` instead of a design token, so it won't adapt to the theme system.
fix: Replace `bg-slate-950/60` with a token-based overlay (e.g. a shared `.modal-overlay` class or `bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--text-primary)_60%,transparent)]`) consistent with other dialogs in the app.

summary: Error state is rendered with EmptyState but there is no visual distinction (no danger token/icon) that this is an error rather than an empty result.
fix: Pass a danger-styled indicator to the error EmptyState (e.g. an AlertTriangle icon and/or `--danger` accent) to differentiate the "تعذر تحميل" error from the normal empty states used elsewhere on the page.

summary: The "اعتماد التعيين" primary hire button relies on a spinner-less disabled state during a pending async mutation with no busy affordance.
fix: Add `aria-busy={workbenchCommands.hireApplicant.isPending}` and a "جارٍ…" label swap (matching the dialog submit buttons at lines 237/255/273) so the pending state is communicated consistently.

summary: Header action buttons are packed inline with no icon aria treatment and the description/actions are the only header spacing—minor inconsistency with other pages using PageHeader eyebrow.
fix: Consider adding an `eyebrow` prop (e.g. "إدارة الموارد") to PageHeader to match sibling management pages that use the eyebrow slot for section context; otherwise this is acceptable.

summary: Destructive action buttons use the hardcoded Tailwind color text-red-700 instead of the --danger design token, so they do not adapt to dark theme and drift from the brand danger color.
fix: Replace `btn-secondary text-red-700` with `btn-secondary text-[var(--danger)]` on all destructive buttons (revoke device, revoke access, reject break-glass, reject privacy) at lines 80, 82, 84, 86 so they use the token that responds to [data-theme='dark'].

summary:
The loading state is a bespoke plain `

جارٍ تحميل…

` instead of the shared LoadingScreen spinner/branding used across the app.
fix: Import and render `<LoadingScreen label="جارٍ تحميل بيانات الحوكمة…" />` (from ../../ui/LoadingScreen) when query.isLoading, matching the loading pattern used by sibling pages.

summary: The devices table is a hand-rolled `<table>` with raw utility classes (bg-[var(--surface-muted)], p-4, border-t) rather than the shared .data-table class used elsewhere, causing spacing/border inconsistencies.
fix: Apply the shared `.data-table` class to the `<table>` (and drop the redundant per-cell p-4/border-t/bg utilities) so device listing matches the app's canonical table styling and cell padding.

summary: The tab navigation buttons convey the active tab only via btn-primary vs btn-secondary styling, with no aria-selected/aria-current, so assistive tech cannot tell which section is active.
fix: Add `aria-current={tab===value ? 'page' : undefined}` (or use role="tab"/aria-selected on a role="tablist" container) to each nav button so the active section is exposed to screen readers, not color-only.

summary:
Empty lists render a plain `

لا توجد…

` (lines 82, 84, 86) instead of the shared EmptyState primitive already imported and used for the error state.
fix: Replace the bespoke muted paragraphs with `<EmptyState title=... description=... />` (e.g. title="لا توجد عناصر مراجعة معلقة") so empty states are visually consistent with the rest of the app.

summary: Policy cards mix inconsistent card padding (p-5 here vs the devices/access panels using border-b header + p-5 body), and the release cards use p-5 while metric grid and forms vary, giving uneven spacing across tabs.
fix: Standardize card internal padding to the app convention (p-5 body with a bordered header where a title exists), and ensure the policy cards follow the same header/body structure as the devices/access/breakglass panels for visual rhythm.

summary: The refresh button's RefreshCcw icon lacks aria-hidden, so screen readers may announce it redundantly alongside the visible 'تحديث' label (StatusBadge icons correctly set aria-hidden).
fix: Add `aria-hidden="true"` to the `<RefreshCcw className="size-4"/>` icon (and any other decorative lucide icons rendered next to text) to match the StatusBadge convention.

summary: Loading state is a bare text paragraph 'جارٍ التحميل…' instead of the shared LoadingScreen / skeleton pattern used across the app.
fix:
Replace the `

جارٍ التحميل…

` fallback with `` (or a card skeleton) for consistency with the rest of the app.

summary: The modal close button is an icon-only '✕' glyph with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing meaningful.
fix: Add `aria-label="إغلاق"` (and ideally the `icon-button` class or lucide X icon) to the close `<button type="button">`.

summary: The modal dialog lacks dialog semantics (no role="dialog", aria-modal, aria-labelledby) and no focus/escape handling.
fix: Add `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby` referencing the heading id to the modal wrapper for accessible modal semantics.

summary: Modal overlay uses hardcoded Tailwind color `bg-slate-950/60` instead of a design token, breaking token consistency and dark-theme adaptability.
fix: Use a token-based scrim, e.g. a defined overlay token or `bg-[var(--surface-strong)]/60`, instead of `bg-slate-950/60`.

summary: The Save button `<button className="btn-primary">حفظ الجدولة</button>` omits `type="submit"` and has no pending/disabled state during the async mutation.
fix: Add `type="submit"` and disable/show a spinner while `commands.upsert.isPending` to match the app's form submission pattern.

summary: Form field labels use a bespoke inline `Field` component rather than shared label styling, and the 'channels' draft state is never editable in the form.
fix: Align Field markup with the shared label styling used elsewhere; either expose a channels selector or drop the unused channels UI concern.

summary: The schedules and runs lists have no search/filter affordance despite potentially long lists, diverging from the FilterBar pattern used on comparable list pages.
fix: Add a FilterBar (search + result count) above the schedules list if the dataset can grow, for consistency with other management list pages.

summary: Multiple statements and JSX are collapsed onto single very long lines, hurting readability and diff-ability versus the rest of the codebase.
fix: Split the component body, header JSX, and modal form onto normally-formatted multi-line JSX consistent with sibling files.

summary: The page renders nothing while the query is loading (no skeleton/spinner), so users see a blank page after the header on first load, unlike the sibling OnboardingPage which shows a loading indicator.
fix:
Between the header and the metrics section, render a loading state when q.isLoading is true (e.g. the LoadingScreen pattern or a `

جارٍ تحميل التقارير…

` matching OnboardingPage line 36).

summary: There is no error state; if the query fails, `d` is undefined and the page silently shows only the header with no feedback, diverging from the app pattern that renders an EmptyState/error banner on q.isError.
fix: Add `{q.isError ? <EmptyState title="تعذر تحميل التقارير" description={q.error instanceof Error ? q.error.message : 'تحقق من الصلاحيات'} /> : null}` (import EmptyState), mirroring OnboardingPage line 37.

summary: The export button reimplements the .btn-primary style inline (`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50`) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class used by sibling pages.
fix: Replace the inline utility classes on the export button with `className="btn-primary"` (as OnboardingPage line 35 does), keeping only the onClick/disabled props and the icon.

summary: All five MetricCards use the identical generic FileBarChart icon, giving no visual differentiation between metrics and making the icon decorative noise rather than informative.
fix: Assign distinct lucide icons per metric (e.g. Users for الموظفون, UserCheck for النشطون, Inbox/ClipboardList for الطلبات, Clock for مراجعات الحضور, Target for KPI) to match the differentiated-icon convention used in other summary sections.

summary: The whole component and its download handler are collapsed onto a single minified line, which is inconsistent with the readable multi-line formatting of every other page in the feature folder.
fix: Reformat the file with normal line breaks/indentation (one statement per line, JSX broken across lines) to match OnboardingPage and the rest of the codebase; this is purely stylistic with no logic change.

summary: Overdue due-date text uses hardcoded text-red-700 instead of the --danger design token, so it will not adapt to dark theme and diverges from the token system.
fix: Replace text-red-700 with an inline style color:'var(--danger)' (e.g. style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}) or a token-based utility so the color follows the design system and dark theme.

summary: The overdue card highlight ring uses hardcoded ring-red-500/30 rather than the --danger token used elsewhere in the app.
fix: Replace ring-1 ring-red-500/30 with a token-driven ring, e.g. style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px var(--danger-soft)' }} or a shared danger ring class, so the accent matches the design tokens in both themes.

summary: The page reimplements its own filter/search bar with a raw label+input instead of reusing the shared FilterBar primitive, duplicating structure and losing its heading, clear, and result-count affordances.
fix: Render the search via <FilterBar searchValue={search} onSearchChange={setSearch} searchPlaceholder="رقم الطلب، الموظف، أو الخدمة…" resultText={...} isDirty={...} onClear={...}> and pass the status chips as children, matching other management pages.

summary: The filter bar shows no result count and provides no clear/reset control, unlike FilterBar's resultText and onClear pattern used across the app.
fix: Add a result count (e.g. `عرض ${visible.length} من ${data.length}`) via FilterBar's resultText and a clear button (isDirty/onClear) that resets search to '' and status to 'open'.

summary: The error state reuses EmptyState (a neutral empty placeholder) rather than a distinct error banner, so a load failure looks identical to a benign empty list and is not visually flagged as an error.
fix: Render the failure in an error-styled banner (danger tokens / role="alert") consistent with the app's error pattern instead of the neutral EmptyState component.

summary: The status filter chips convey the active selection with visual .is-active styling only, without aria-pressed, so screen-reader users cannot tell which filter is selected.
fix: Add aria-pressed={status === id} to each filter-chip button so the toggle state is exposed to assistive technology.

summary: The loading skeleton grid uses lg:grid-cols-2 while the actual results grid uses xl:grid-cols-2, causing a layout jump at the lg breakpoint when data loads.
fix: Align the skeleton grid breakpoint with the results grid by using xl:grid-cols-2 on the loading section to keep the column count stable across load.

summary: The loading skeleton renders only card placeholders and omits skeletons for the four MetricCards, so the metrics row pops in abruptly after load.
fix: Also render placeholder skeletons (or the MetricCards with muted/zero values) for the metrics row during query.isLoading so the whole page fades in consistently.

summary: The page renders no loading indicator while q.isLoading is true — during initial load the user sees an empty screen (no spinner, skeleton, or text), unlike every other feature page.
fix: Add a loading branch consistent with the app pattern, e.g. right after the error/empty checks: {q.isLoading ? <section className="space-y-3" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل الإشعارات">{[1,2,3].map(i=><div key={i} className="card h-24 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" />)}</section> : null} (matching LiveLocationPage/ServiceDeskPage skeleton style).

summary: The 'تعليم الكل كمقروء' header action is a bespoke button with hand-rolled border/padding/font classes instead of reusing the shared .btn-secondary class.
fix: Replace the inline className with the shared primitive: className="btn-secondary" (keep the CheckCheck icon + gap), so the button matches the design-system button height, radius, hover/disabled states.

summary: The 'فتح' link is a bespoke primary button (bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-white) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class used for primary CTAs elsewhere.
fix: Change the Link className to "btn-primary text-sm" so it inherits the standard primary-button gradient/tokens, radius, and states.

summary: Multiple hardcoded brand utilities (text-brand, bg-brand, border-brand/40) are used instead of design tokens; the 'جديد' badge and unread-border rely on ad-hoc brand classes rather than --brand-primary / --brand-primary-soft tokens.
fix: Use token-based styling: unread border via border-[var(--brand-primary)]/soft, the 'جديد' badge via bg-[var(--brand-primary)] text-white, and the bell icon via text-[var(--brand-primary)], matching the tokenized approach used in LoadingScreen and other pages.

summary: The error state uses EmptyState instead of the app's error-banner pattern, and when q.isError is true the empty-state check can also evaluate, but more importantly an errored fetch shows a generic empty look rather than a distinct danger-styled banner.
fix: Render the error as a danger banner (e.g. a .card with border/text using --danger tokens and role="alert") separate from the neutral EmptyState, so failed loads are visually distinct from 'no notifications'.

summary: The unread state is conveyed only via opacity/border/color and a 'جديد' badge without a text alternative on the item itself, and the bell icon span has no aria-hidden, adding noise to screen readers.
fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to the decorative bell icon span, and ensure unread status is programmatically exposed (e.g. aria-label on the article indicating 'غير مقروء'), avoiding reliance on color/opacity alone.

summary:
The notification date is rendered as a raw formatted string in a

with no element or machine-readable datetime, reducing semantic clarity.
fix: Wrap the formatted date in <time dateTime={new Date(n.createdAt).toISOString()}>…</time> for semantic/a11y correctness.

Add a loading branch mirroring sibling pages, e.g. {q.isLoading ?

جارٍ تحميل الحالة التقنية…

: null} (or a skeleton), placed alongside the isError branch before the data block.
summary: The page renders no loading indicator while the query is fetching; nothing appears below the header until data or error arrives, unlike the app pattern in OrganizationPage.

fix:
Wrap the flags map with a length check and a fallback like the errors section: {d.flags.length ? d.flags.map(...) :

}.
summary: The Feature Flags list has no empty-state fallback, so when d.flags is empty the card body renders empty, whereas the errors card correctly shows a fallback message.

fix: Gate the data block on success only, e.g. {d && !q.isError ? ... : null}, so the error EmptyState is shown alone rather than alongside cached data.
summary: When the query errors, both the EmptyState and (if cached) the data block can render together because the data block is gated only on d, not on !q.isError.

fix: Standardize the card section headers (reuse the OrganizationPage pattern: a header row with <h2 className="font-black"> plus an optional muted subtitle) for visual consistency across management pages.
summary: The two section headings use bespoke <h2 className="font-black"> with no size/spacing token, inconsistent with sibling section headers that pair a heading with a muted subtitle.

fix: Add missing level keys (e.g. 'fatal') to the StatusBadge map in src/ui/StatusBadge.tsx with tone 'danger', or normalize e.level to a known key before passing it.
summary: Error badges pass e.level directly to StatusBadge; a level such as 'fatal' is not in the map and falls back to a neutral badge showing the raw English key, breaking Arabic localization and color semantics.

fix: Use an Arabic label such as 'آخر نسخة احتياطية' for the backup MetricCard to match the surrounding Arabic labels.
summary: Metric label 'آخر Backup' mixes an English word into Arabic UI text where an Arabic term is available, unlike other fully-Arabic metric labels.

fix: Pass a danger-toned hint or trend to the fatalErrors/unresolvedErrors MetricCards when count > 0 so severity is not conveyed by the number alone.
summary: The fatalErrors/unresolvedErrors metric cards give no visual severity emphasis (e.g. danger accent), so critical counts read visually identical to neutral zero counts.

fix: Optionally render a token-based progress meter (bg-[var(--surface-subtle)] track with a --brand-primary fill) for rolloutPercent to make the value scannable.
summary: The flags rollout line 'نسبة الإطلاق: {rolloutPercent}%' is plain muted text with no visual meter, a missed polish opportunity given the available surface/border tokens.
On error, both the error EmptyState (line 28) and the "لا توجد تقييمات" EmptyState (line 29) render at once because isLoading is false and items is empty, showing two stacked empty states.
fix: Guard the second EmptyState against the error state: change the condition to {!query.isLoading && !query.isError && items.length === 0 ? <EmptyState .../> : null}.

summary: The page has no loading skeleton/placeholder while query.isLoading is true; the list section just renders empty, unlike the app-wide pattern of animate-pulse skeletons.
fix: Add a loading branch before the list, e.g. {query.isLoading ? <section className="space-y-4" aria-label="جارٍ تحميل التقييمات">{[1,2,3].map((i) => <div key={i} className="card h-40 animate-pulse bg-[var(--surface-muted)]" />)}</section> : null}, matching LiveLocationPage/ServiceDeskPage.

summary: The score/rating/deadline chips repeat the bespoke inline utility string 'rounded-xl bg-[var(--surface-muted)] px-3 py-2 text-sm' three times instead of a shared class.
fix: Extract the repeated chip styling into a small local const className (or a shared .chip class in styles.css) and reuse it for all three spans to keep them consistent.

summary: PageHeader is used without the eyebrow prop that other pages use for section context, so the Performance page lacks the standard eyebrow label above the title.
fix: Pass an eyebrow such as eyebrow="الأداء" (or the relevant section label) to PageHeader for consistency with the established header pattern.

summary: The KpiEvaluationEditor is rendered inline between the FilterBar/empty-states and the list, so opening an evaluation injects a large editor mid-page above the results rather than in a clear focused location.
fix: Move the {selected ? <KpiEvaluationEditor .../> : null} render above the list section top (or into a modal/dedicated region) so the editor has a stable, predictable anchor instead of pushing the results list down.

summary: Decision buttons use hardcoded Tailwind palette colors (bg-emerald-600, bg-red-600, text-red-600) instead of the semantic success/danger design tokens.
fix: Replace bg-emerald-600 with bg-[var(--success)] (or a shared success button class), bg-red-600 with bg-[var(--danger)], and text-red-600 on the error message with text-[var(--danger)] so approve/reject respect the token palette and dark theme.

summary: There is no loading state: while query.isLoading is true the page renders empty content (balances/list sections are just empty) with no skeleton or LoadingScreen, unlike the app pattern.
fix: Render a loading indicator when query.isLoading (e.g. LoadingScreen or card skeletons in the list section) before falling through to the empty/error states, matching the established loading pattern.

summary: Leave-balance cards are a bespoke card+icon reimplementation of MetricCard (label/value/hint/icon), duplicating layout that the shared MetricCard primitive provides.
fix: Render each balance via <MetricCard label={`رصيد ${balance.nameAr}`} value={balance.availableUnits} hint={`محجوز ${balance.reservedUnits} · مستهلك ${balance.consumedUnits}`} icon={CalendarDays} /> to reuse the shared primitive and its metric-card/metric-icon tokens.

summary: The 'مراجعة واتخاذ إجراء' action button uses ad-hoc utility classes (rounded-xl bg-brand px-4 py-2 font-black text-white) instead of the shared .btn-primary class.
fix: Replace the inline classes with className="btn-primary mr-auto" so the primary action matches the app-wide button styling, focus ring, and hover states.

summary: The decision modal has role="dialog" aria-modal but no aria-labelledby/aria-describedby, so screen readers get no accessible name for the dialog.
fix: Add an id to the modal's <h2> title and reference it via aria-labelledby on the dialog container (and optionally aria-describedby pointing at the reason block).

summary: Close button uses a bare bordered box; other icon buttons in the app use the shared .icon-button styling.
fix: Give the close button className="icon-button" instead of 'rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] p-2' to match the shared icon-button treatment while keeping the aria-label.

summary: The reject button is disabled when the comment is under 3 characters but gives no visible/aria explanation, so the disabled reason is not communicated.
fix: Add aria-describedby pointing at a hint (or title) explaining that rejection requires a reason of at least 3 characters, so the disabled state is discoverable.

summary: The overlay lacks a click-outside-to-close affordance and Escape handling, unlike a standard modal, leaving only the small close button.
fix: Add an onClick on the backdrop div that calls setSelected(null) (with stopPropagation on the inner section) to allow dismissing by clicking the overlay, consistent with modal conventions.

summary: No loading state is rendered while the overview query is fetching; when data is undefined and there is no error the metrics grid, pulse, priorities and scope sections all render empty/blank with zero feedback to the user.
fix: Add a loading branch (e.g. after the hero, when query.isLoading show skeleton MetricCards or a 'جارٍ تحميل اللوحة…' placeholder consistent with the app's loading text pattern) so the dashboard body is not blank during fetch.

summary: The hero description uses the hardcoded Tailwind color class text-blue-100 instead of a design token, bypassing the token system used elsewhere.
fix: Replace text-blue-100 with a token-based hero-foreground color (e.g. a dedicated CSS class like .hero-eyebrow already used above, or a token var) so the hero text color is centralized and theme-aware.

summary: The error state uses a full EmptyState card but the metrics/pulse/priorities sections still render below it (empty), producing an inconsistent error screen versus other pages that short-circuit the body on error.
fix: When query.isError, return early after the hero + EmptyState (or hide the metric/pulse/priority sections) so only the error card shows, matching the app's error-handling pattern.

summary: The pulse progress bars convey their value only via bar width and a numeric badge with no ARIA progress semantics, so assistive tech reads them as decorative divs.
fix: Add role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax (and aria-label from item.label) to the .progress-track element so screen readers announce each pulse metric.

summary: Hero quick-action Links lack any aria-label/title and rely solely on visible text plus an icon; acceptable but the icon has no aria-hidden so it may be announced redundantly.
fix: Add aria-hidden="true" to the decorative <Icon> inside each hero-action (and in priority-item / pulse rows) to prevent redundant icon announcements.

summary: Status is rendered as raw inline text ('الحالة: مقبول') instead of the shared MobileStatusPill, which every other list page uses for status display.
fix: Replace the 'الحالة: ...' Text with a MobileStatusPill. Since this page's status vocabulary (accepted/flagged/adjusted) differs from the pill's built-in cases, either extend MobileStatusPill with these values or map them to existing keys, so status is shown as a colored pill consistent with the rest of the app.

summary: The 'قيد المراجعة' review indicator uses a bare Material Chip instead of MobileStatusPill (or the 'flagged' status token), breaking the app's radius-99 status-pill styling.
fix: Replace the Chip(label: Text('قيد المراجعة')) with const MobileStatusPill('flagged') so the review badge matches the shared status pill styling and color palette.

summary: The empty-state icon uses the default (full-opacity onSurface) color and no BrandLogoMark, whereas sibling pages mute empty/placeholder icons with onSurfaceVariant.
fix: Give the empty-state Icon a color of Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant (and optionally the muted title text too), or lead the empty card with a BrandLogoMark, to match the muted empty-state convention used elsewhere.

summary: The error state is a plain text Card with no error icon, no color emphasis, and no retry affordance, which is thinner than the app's other error states.
fix: Add an Icon(Icons.error_outline, color: colorScheme.error) and a retry TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(myAttendanceHistoryProvider) inside the error Card, and tint the message with colorScheme.error for consistency.

summary: Secondary metadata lines (date, verification, late minutes, accuracy) all use the default onSurface color instead of onSurfaceVariant used for secondary text across the design system.
fix: Apply style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(color: colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant) to the metadata Text widgets (lines 95, 97-102) so secondary detail reads as muted, matching MetricCard/MobileSectionHeader conventions.

summary: The check-in/check-out CircleAvatar icon has no Semantics label and no color coding, so screen readers and glance-scanning get no cue distinguishing حضور from انصراف beyond the title.
fix: Wrap the leading icon (or CircleAvatar) with a Semantics(label: checkIn ? 'حضور' : 'انصراف') and optionally color-code the avatar (e.g. green-tinted for check-in) so the event type is conveyed accessibly and at a glance.

summary: CircleAvatar uses the default theme fill (primary-ish) for both check-in and check-out, giving no visual distinction between the two opposite event types.
fix: Set the CircleAvatar backgroundColor/foregroundColor from colorScheme based on checkIn (e.g. surfaceContainerHighest with onSurfaceVariant icon, differentiated by event) to visually separate check-in from check-out.

Read scheme.primary and scheme.secondary from Theme.of(context).colorScheme for the two brand stops (keep only a genuinely bespoke darker stop via Color.lerp(scheme.primary, Colors.black, .25) if needed), and use scheme.primary.withValues(alpha:.22) for the boxShadow color on line 41 instead of const Color(0xFF0B4FA2).
summary: The hero gradient hardcodes the brand and accent hex values (0xFF073B7A, 0xFF0B4FA2, 0xFF00A8D6) instead of deriving from the theme, so it duplicates the seed colors and will not track ColorScheme changes.

fix: Use Colors.white.withValues(alpha:.9) (consistent with the other on-gradient white text in the hero) instead of const Color(0xFFD6F5FF) so the tint is not an untracked one-off.
summary: The date pill text color is a hardcoded Color(0xFFD6F5FF) rather than a theme-derived on-gradient color.

fix: Change BorderRadius.circular(24) to BorderRadius.circular(20) to match the established card radius used by every Card and _QuickAction below.
summary: The hero container uses borderRadius 24, but the design-system card radius is 20.

fix: Show a fixed friendly Arabic message (e.g. 'تعذر تحميل ملخص حسابك') as the primary text and keep the raw message only as a smaller muted secondary line, matching how other pages present errors.
summary: _ErrorCard renders raw error.toString() directly to the user, exposing technical exception text instead of a friendly Arabic message.

fix: Add a BrandLogoMark (white variant) into the hero top Row (near the date pill or in place of the decorative wb_sunny icon) so the primary landing header carries brand identity.
summary: The hero header shows no brand logo mark, though guidance calls for the brand logo to appear in headers/hero areas.

fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleSmall?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) (matching MetricCard/section-header styling) so font sizing and color come from the theme.
summary: _QuickAction title uses a bespoke const TextStyle(fontSize:13, fontWeight:w900) with no themed color instead of a textTheme style.
